title: Less Out of Africa
summary: What are the implications for tanker demand? Nigeria's crude oil production and exports have been hit by severe outages as a result of attacks on oil infrastructure by rebel fighters in the Niger River Delta. Various sources report that Qua Iboe Terminal has shut down operations until further notice.
